tasks.dev:web: cd apps/web && deno run -A --node-modules-dir npm:vite --mode dev
tasks.build:web: cd apps/web && deno run -A --node-modules-dir npm:vite build --mode production
tasks.preview:web: cd apps/web && deno run -A --node-modules-dir npm:vite preview
tasks.serve:web: cd apps/web && deno run --allow-net --allow-read jsr:@std/http@1/file-server dist/
tasks.dev: deno task dev:api & deno task dev:web
tasks.deploy: deno task deploy:api & deno task deploy:web
